critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single-file backend (~250 lines) — acceptable for current scope.
Admin password is hashed at startup from env var ADMIN_PASSWORD — OK. JWT expires in 7 days — reasonable.
Booking endpoint is unauthenticated by design (public booking form) — correct.
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL throughout (no hardcoded URLs observed).
